area: AREA 4 — machine/creature staging (G-STAGE battery gate, creature-face wall, prop-sheet existence hook)
summary: Root problem: the plan can show a machine/vessel/creature by a bare word ("a Martian wading", "tripod") without the card name in the prose, without the pid in Setup.props, and with a creature row standing in Shot.faces — so the grid stages a humanoid character sheet (or nothing) and Qwen draws a naked humanoid; separately, a staged pid with no refs/props/<pid>/sheet.png is SILENTLY dropped by pack_refs.props_named's `(sheet := prop_sheet(...))` filter, so the machine vanishes from grid and take with no fault anywhere. Mechanism: (1) a hard battery gate G-STAGE in plan_check built from a chapter-filtered vocabulary (prop cards of kind machine/vessel/vehicle via pack_refs.prop_terms + refs.json rows with gender=="creature") that refuses any shot/setup text naming a card by alias without card-name tokens + staged pid, and a sibling G-FACE-KIND that refuses a creature id anywhere in Shot.faces/SubShot.faces/Setup.cast; (2) mechanical cures in plan_cures (rename to card name + append first physical clause at first mention, add pid to Setup.props, strip creature sentences from setup text, drop creature faces, copy a verbatim chapter sentence as the G-SOURCE span the new prop claim needs) dispatched by plan_repair with new CURES rows inserted ABOVE the existing `"prop "` catch-all (which currently mis-captures these rows into legal_props); one tiny workhorse-tier llm.structured call only when a bare creature word maps to ≥2 candidate cards; (3) the sheet-existence hook lives in step 03 (new substep 03_02, between places --draw and write_cells, and in done()) drawing missing sheets free via build_pack.draw imported directly, with an llm fallback that writes a missing design.sheet_prompt; (4) grids.props_of and takes_r2v gain a SystemExit backstop via new pack_refs.undrawn_named so a named-but-undrawn prop can never again be silently dropped.

gates.where: studio/plan_gates.py new stage_faults(episode, vocab) (place it directly under close_crowd_faults, line ~456); printed+counted in scripts/episode/plan_check.py main() immediately after the G-CROWD-CLOSE block (currently lines ~225-228) — hoist the `refs = episode_home.read_json(book / 'refs' / 'refs.json')["refs"]` read (currently just above MARKS) up above this block and build `vocab = pack_refs.stage_vocab(book, refs, number)` once
gates.rule: Vocabulary: vocab = {"machines": {pid: {"name": card name, "terms": pack_refs.prop_terms(book,pid), "physical": profile.physical}}, "creatures": {cid: head-noun terms of the refs.json row's name/display}} — machines limited to analysis/props cards whose `kind` ∈ {"machine","vessel","vehicle"} AND whose `appears` lists this episode's chapter number (episode number == chapter number per plan_brief.chapter_paragraphs ch_{number:02d}); creatures = refs.json character rows with gender=="creature" (e.g. martians -> {martian}). Faults, using the existing pack_refs.names_prop word-boundary test and plan_gates.claim_prose(shot): (a) shot prose names a machine term and pid NOT in episode.setups[shot.setup].props -> fault("G-STAGE", f"shot {s.index}", f"names {pid} by {term!r} and the setup stages no sheet", term, "card name + setup props entry"); (b) machine term named, pid staged, but prose lacks the card-name test plan_gates.staged_props already uses (a pid token >3 letters) -> fault "...by the bare word {term!r}, not its card name"; (c) setup.described/crowd/geometry names a machine term without card name+pid -> same fault keyed f"setup {name}"; (d) after masking every staged machine card's `name` phrase out of the text (so 'the Martian fighting-machine' never re-fires on 'Martian'), any creature term in shot prose or setup text -> fault "bare creature word {term!r}; a drawn creature is its machine card". Always hard — a cured plan correctly stales drawn grids via the existing panels.stale_grids plan_sha path.

gates.where: studio/plan_gates.py new creature_face_faults(episode, creature_ids: set[str]), printed+counted in plan_check.main right after G-STAGE
gates.rule: No creature id in Shot.faces, SubShot.faces (shot.cuts) or Setup.cast: for each hit, fault("G-FACE-KIND", f"shot {s.index}"|f"setup {name}", f"{cid!r} is a creature row staged as a face; its drawn form is a prop card", cid, "no creature-kind faces"). This is distinct from takes_r2v.adopt_names (which refuses a MISSING gender at render time, line ~196); this refuses at the plan, before anything is drawn.

gates.where: render-time backstop, two call sites: scripts/episode/grids.py props_of (line 250) and scripts/episode/takes_r2v.py just before the pack_refs.props_named staging at line ~482; both call new studio/pack_refs.py undrawn_named(book, pids, text) -> list[str]
gates.rule: undrawn_named returns pids where names_prop(text, prop_terms(book,pid)) is true but prop_sheet(book,pid) is None — the exact set props_named today drops silently. Both call sites raise SystemExit(f"prop {pid!r} is named by the prose and refs/props/{pid}/sheet.png is not drawn; run step 03") instead of rendering without the machine. This is the wall behind the 03_02 hook; it should never fire in a driven run.

gates.where: scripts/episode/step_03_places.py: new substep in run(ctx) between the places.py --draw line and the `if not rendered(ctx): write_cells(ctx)` line; done(ctx) (line ~82) gains `and not missing_sheets(ctx.book_dir, doc)`
gates.rule: plan_props(doc) = sorted({pid for setup in doc['setups'].values() for pid in setup.get('props') or []}); missing_sheets(book, doc) = [pid for pid in plan_props(doc) if pack_refs.prop_sheet(book, pid) is None]. run() draws each missing pid BEFORE cells and long before step 07, so grids/takes always find the sheet. Hook decision: step 03, not a step 07 pre-check — step 03 is the first GPU step after a clean battery, 03_03's cells and the panel gates downstream must see the same staged world, and extending done() makes drive.py re-enter idempotently (five-hour-episode P0: idempotent pictures). Step 07 keeps no hook; its protection is the G-SHEET-DRAWN SystemExit.

cures.fault: G-STAGE rows (a)(b)(c): bare machine word / card name absent / pid not staged
cures.how: studio/plan_cures.py new stage_machines(doc, vocab) -> dict. For each shot field in (frame, motion, at_rest, end) and setup field in (described, crowd, geometry): for each machine pid whose term matches by names_prop, regex-replace the matched noun phrase `(?:the |a |an )?\b{term}s?\b` (first occurrence per field) with the card's `name` from vocab (names already lead with 'the', so strip a preceding article to avoid 'the the'); add pid to doc['setups'][shot['setup']]['props'] (or the faulting setup's own props) if absent, preserving list order. At the FIRST cured mention of a pid in the whole episode only, append ', ' + first clause of the card's `physical` capped at 12 words after the card name (owner rule: described in the shot); every later mention gets the name alone — the full definition still reaches every take via pack_refs.prop_row/props_named and the sheet reaches every grid via props_of, so prose stays short. Dispatch: insert (re.compile(r'G-STAGE'), 'stage_machines') in plan_cures.CURES ABOVE the existing (r'props.*\.json|names setup .* not defined|prop ', 'legal_props') row — that catch-all currently swallows any row containing 'prop ' and would mis-route these to a no-op. plan_repair.apply() builds vocab = pack_refs.stage_vocab(book, refs_rows, number) once (refs_rows read from book/refs/refs.json) and adds elif branches for every new cure name.

cures.fault: G-STAGE row (d) in SETUP text: bare creature word in described/crowd/geometry
cures.how: studio/plan_cures.py new strip_creatures(doc, vocab) -> dict: split the field on sentence ends, drop every sentence containing a creature term not inside a staged machine card name (mask card names first, same helper as the gate), rejoin. A creature is never scenery of a place picture (ep17/18 hand fix: people and 'A Martian' removed from setup descriptions). Dispatched by a CURES row (re.compile(r'bare creature word'), 'strip_creatures') matching only setup-keyed rows — make the gate's setup-row text say 'setup' so the pattern r"G-STAGE setup" can key it: use (re.compile(r'G-STAGE.*bare creature'), see dispatcher note) with the shot/setup split done inside plan_repair by inspecting the row's 'setup ' vs 'shot ' prefix.

cures.fault: G-STAGE row (d) in SHOT prose: bare creature word, exactly ONE candidate machine card
cures.how: Inside stage_machines: candidates = machine pids already in that shot's setup.props, else the chapter-filtered vocab machines; when exactly one candidate exists, rename the creature phrase `(?:a |the )?\b{term}s?\b` to that card's name and stage the pid exactly as in the machine cure (ep17 shot 14: 'a Martian wading' -> 'the Martian fighting-machine wading', fighting_machine appended to the setup's props).

cures.fault: G-STAGE row (d) in SHOT prose: bare creature word, >=2 candidate machine cards (or a machine term colliding across two cards)
cures.how: New studio/stage_pick.py: class MachinePick(BaseModel): pid: str (validator: raise ValueError listing the candidates when pid not among them, so llm.structured's StructuredOutputException re-ask ladder fires); def pick_machine(prose: str, candidates: list[dict], *, _structured=None) -> str calls (_structured or studio.llm.structured)('workhorse', prompt, MachinePick, retries=3) and returns .pid. Every paid path goes through studio/llm.structured -> _NativeStructuredCaller -> guard_spend(model, prompt) against money.episode_ceiling_usd=$3, spend recorded by _record_spend. plan_repair.apply() calls it only for shot-keyed creature rows stage_machines returned as unresolved (stage_machines returns (doc, unresolved: list[tuple[shot_index, term, candidate_pids]])), then re-runs the rename mechanically with the picked pid. ~500 tokens in / ~15 out on gpt-5.6-luna ($0.20/$1.20 per M).

cures.fault: a staged pid claim added by the cure now needs a chapter span (G-SOURCE: "prop 'X' has no chapter span")
cures.how: studio/plan_cures.py new prop_spans(doc, paragraphs, vocab) -> dict: for each shot whose prose passes plan_gates.staged_props for pid but whose source list has no span matching any of prop_terms(pid): candidates = chapter sentences (split paragraphs on sentence ends) containing any term of pid; anchor = plan_gates.span_paragraph of the shot's existing spans (else the nearest neighbour shot's); choose the candidate sentence whose paragraph index is nearest the anchor and append it VERBATIM (trimmed to <=25 words around the term) to shot['source'] — verbatim copy guarantees span_match >= SPAN_MATCH 0.85. Zero candidates -> leave the row uncured (creative path, the writer's). Dispatch: insert (re.compile(r"prop '.+' has no chapter span"), 'prop_spans') ABOVE the legal_props catch-all; plan_repair passes paragraphs from plan_brief.chapter_paragraphs(book, number)[1].

studio/plan_cures.py new drop_creature_faces(doc, creature_ids) -> dict: filter creature ids out of every shot['faces'], every cut['faces'] in shot['cuts'], and every setup['cast']; never touches human ids or extras. CURES row (re.compile(r'G-FACE-KIND'), 'drop_creature_faces'). Runs in the same round as stage_machines, so the shot that loses its 'martians' face gains the fighting-machine card name in the same repair pass.

cures.fault: a setup prop with no refs/props/<pid>/sheet.png (the thunder_child hand-draw)
cures.how: scripts/episode/step_03_places.py new draw_prop_sheets(ctx, doc) (substep 03_02): for pid in missing_sheets(ctx.book_dir, doc): profile = json.loads((book/'analysis'/'props'/f'{pid}.json').read_text())['profile']; jobs = studio.refs_pack.prop_jobs(pid, profile); for job in jobs: scripts.refs.build_pack.draw(book, job) + build_pack.log(book, job, seconds) — direct import, NOT the CLI (build_pack's CLI takes book_id positional while ctx.run_script injects codex_id+episode and the signatures do not line up); free local GPU (image_krea2_cinematic_2x, seed = refs_pack.seed_for(relpath), so a rerun redraws the same picture). ctx.log each drawn path; keep the function 10-20 lines by letting build_pack.draw/log do the work.

cures.fault: a card whose profile.design has no sheet_prompt (prop_jobs returns [] and nothing can draw)
cures.how: studio/stage_pick.py: class SheetPrompt(BaseModel): prompt: str = Field(min_length=40, max_length=600); def write_sheet_prompt(card: dict, example_prompts: list[str], *, _structured=None) -> str via studio.llm.structured('workhorse', prompt, SheetPrompt, retries=3). draw_prop_sheets calls it when prop_jobs returns [], writes the result into analysis/props/<pid>.json at profile.design.sheet_prompt (json round-trip, keep every other key byte-identical), then draws. example_prompts = up to 2 existing sheet_prompts from the same book's props folder (the house form travels by example, the code tree names no book). WotW today: 39/39 cards already carry one, so this path is rare.
cures.est_cost_usd: 0.0005 per call; 0 calls on a fully-designed book

files.change: Add STAGE_KINDS = ("machine", "vessel", "vehicle"); stage_vocab(book, refs_rows, chapter) -> dict building {machines: {pid: {name, terms, physical}}, creatures: {cid: terms}} — machines from analysis/props/*.json where row['kind'] in STAGE_KINDS and any(a['chapter'] == chapter for a in row['appears']), terms via existing prop_terms (reuse GENERIC filtering); creature_terms(rows) head-nouns of name/display for character rows with gender=='creature'; mask_card_names(text, names) helper; undrawn_named(book, pids, text) -> [pid for pid in pids if names_prop(text, prop_terms(book,pid)) and not prop_sheet(book,pid)]. Each function 10-20 lines.

Add stage_faults(episode, vocab) and creature_face_faults(episode, creature_ids) below close_crowd_faults (~line 456), using the existing fault()/claim_prose()/staged_props() helpers and pack_refs.names_prop/mask_card_names; no book parameter — the vocab is passed in (gate stays pure).

In main(): hoist the refs.json read above the gate block; after the G-CROWD-CLOSE print (~line 225-228) add vocab = pack_refs.stage_vocab(book, refs, number); print/count G-STAGE (plan_gates.stage_faults) and G-FACE-KIND (plan_gates.creature_face_faults) as hard, same print style as G-CROWD-CLOSE.

Add stage_machines(doc, vocab) -> (doc, unresolved), strip_creatures(doc, vocab), drop_creature_faces(doc, creature_ids), prop_spans(doc, paragraphs, vocab); insert three CURES rows — (r'G-STAGE', 'stage_machines'), (r'G-FACE-KIND', 'drop_creature_faces'), (r"prop '.+' has no chapter span", 'prop_spans') — ABOVE the existing (r'props.*\.json|names setup .* not defined|prop ', 'legal_props') row, because that 'prop ' catch-all currently captures both new fault families and would route them to the wrong cure.

NEW. Pydantic MachinePick (pid validated against a module-level candidate context or via model_validator fed through a closure — simplest: validate in pick_machine and re-raise as StructuredOutputException-compatible ValueError for the re-ask ladder), SheetPrompt; pick_machine(prose, candidates, *, _structured=None) and write_sheet_prompt(card, example_prompts, *, _structured=None), both defaulting _structured to studio.llm.structured tier 'workhorse' — the _structured kwarg is the FakeModel test seam, mirroring llm.structured's _agent seam.

At the staging site ~line 482, same undrawn_named check over the take's shot prose and setup props, raising SystemExit before props_named filters the missing sheet away.

Add plan_props(doc), missing_sheets(book, doc), draw_prop_sheets(ctx, doc) (03_02, imports scripts.refs.build_pack draw/log + studio.refs_pack.prop_jobs; calls stage_pick.write_sheet_prompt when prop_jobs is empty, writing design.sheet_prompt back into the card json); run(ctx) calls draw_prop_sheets after places.py --draw and before write_cells; done(ctx) adds `and not missing_sheets(ctx.book_dir, doc)` so drive.py re-enters while a sheet is missing.

Per project rules, if the implementer lands 03_02 as a named unit of work: update the Current tab's step 03 entry (CURRENT step table data, not the drawing) and architecture/README.md in the same commit; G-STAGE/G-FACE-KIND are battery gates, not owner gates, and need no org-chart change beyond that.

tests: tests/test_a_bare_machine_word_fails_the_stage_gate.py — builds a minimal Episode fixture (derived from episode_spec, per house rule) with shot prose 'the tripod strides over the lane' and an empty setup.props: asserts plan_gates.stage_faults names fighting_machine and the fault row contains 'G-STAGE' and 'shot'; with the pid staged AND 'the Martian fighting-machine' in the prose, asserts clean; vocab built by hand dicts, no disk, no API.

tests/test_stage_vocab_is_the_chapters_cards_only.py — pack_refs.stage_vocab over a tmp_path book tree with two machine cards (appears ch 14 vs ch 3) and one 'object' card: asserts only the ch-14 machine enters the vocab for chapter 14, the object kind never does, and creature_terms yields {'martians': ['martian']} from a gender=='creature' row.

tests/test_a_bare_creature_word_is_cured_to_its_machine_card.py — plan_cures.stage_machines on a doc with shot 'a Martian wading up the Thames' whose setup stages exactly fighting_machine: asserts prose becomes 'the Martian fighting-machine wading...', the pid stays staged, the first mention carries the physical clause and a second mention does not, and re-running the gate on the cured doc is clean (masking exempts 'Martian' inside the card name).

tests/test_an_ambiguous_creature_word_asks_one_pick.py — stage_pick.pick_machine with _structured=fake returning MachinePick(pid='handling_machine'): asserts the returned pid feeds the rename; a fake returning a pid outside candidates asserts the validation refusal path (re-ask contract), zero network, zero spend.

tests/test_a_creature_row_never_stands_in_faces.py — plan_gates.creature_face_faults over faces, cuts[].faces and setup.cast each holding 'martians': three faults; plan_cures.drop_creature_faces removes all three and leaves human ids untouched.

tests/test_a_cured_prop_claim_copies_its_chapter_span.py — plan_cures.prop_spans with canned paragraphs containing 'The tripod came striding over the pines.': asserts the appended span is verbatim, plan_gates.span_match(span, chapter) >= 0.85, the span lands on the shot that stages the pid, and zero candidates leaves source untouched.

tests/test_stage_rows_dispatch_before_the_prop_catchall.py — plan_cures.cure_for('G-STAGE shot 14 names fighting_machine...') == 'stage_machines'; cure_for("prop 'fighting_machine' has no chapter span") == 'prop_spans' (NOT legal_props); cure_for('G-FACE-KIND shot 14 ...') == 'drop_creature_faces'.

tests/test_a_named_prop_with_no_sheet_refuses_the_grid.py — tmp book tree with a props card but no sheet.png: pack_refs.undrawn_named returns the pid and grids.props_of raises SystemExit naming it; with sheet.png present it stages normally.

tests/test_step_03_draws_the_missing_prop_sheet.py — step_03_places.missing_sheets over a tmp tree; draw_prop_sheets with build_pack.draw monkeypatched to write a stub png: asserts the sheet lands at refs/props/<pid>/sheet.png, done(ctx) flips false->true, and a card with design.sheet_prompt absent routes through stage_pick.write_sheet_prompt (fake _structured) and persists the prompt into the card json. All tests inject fakes; none calls a paid API or the local GPU.
risks: Alias head-noun false positives: 'hood' or 'pony' in innocent prose would trigger a rename; mitigated by chapter-filtering vocab on the card's `appears` and by GENERIC head-noun stripping in prop_terms, and a wrong staging is then exposed by G-SOURCE (the new prop claim has no chapter sentence to copy) — but a false hit in the right chapter still renames prose wrongly.

The cure lengthens prose (card name + one physical clause): L14 LENGTH, the 16-word style caps or G-FIRSTFRAME word economics may fire on the next battery round, and no mechanical cure trims frame text — such a row exits through the existing creative/writer path rather than looping.
strip_creatures removing a sentence from setup.described can drop it under the ~90-word G-FIRSTFRAME floor; same creative-path exit.

A cured plan changes plan sha8 and correctly stales drawn grids/panels (panels.stale_grids), costing a free redraw cycle against the 5-hour episode clock; G-STAGE stays hard even on rendered plans by design — budget the redraw.

Books where the creature IS the walking cast (Frankenstein's creature, a talking animal) must NOT carry gender=='creature' on its refs.json row, or G-FACE-KIND will deface it; the rule keys on the row the book's cast step writes, so document this in the gate docstring (constants outlive their world).

Term collisions across two same-chapter machine cards route to the llm pick; a wrong pick still stages A drawn machine sheet (bounded harm, caught by the owner-audit judges), and every pick passes guard_spend against the $3 ceiling.

plan.verdict.json: all plan edits here go through episode_home.write_plan inside plan_repair/step 03's existing paths, lapsing sha8-bound signatures as designed — but the step-03 card-json write (sheet_prompt) edits analysis/, which no signature covers; keep that write append-only to design.sheet_prompt.
